title: M4RM block multiply register-tile + cache-block
description:
## Current

M4RM `multiply` in `crates/gf2-core/src/alg/m4rm.rs` does straightforward block iteration. No register tile, no explicit prefetch; cache reuse is implicit.

## Fix

PPC walk:

- V4 register tile: M=8 row-accumulators × N=4 column-words pinned in YMM regs through full Gray-table pass.
- V5 refined reuse: increase tile to 32 row accumulators if register pressure allows; tune via asm inspection.
- V6 prefetch: software prefetch of next k-block table while consuming current one.

## Per-kernel execution protocol

Same as B1. Baseline already pinned by I1 (`matmul`, `m4rm_profile`).

## Depends on

I1, I2, I3, I4, B1 (B3's tile-reuse asm path may reuse the transpose primitive added in B1).

## Success criteria

- [hard] Existing M4RM tests pass.
- [hard] ASM artefact shows the M×N tile materialised in registers (no spills) at the chosen tile shape.
- [hard] No regression at small sizes (below the M4RM crossover threshold).
- [aspirational] ≥1.5× geomean on `matmul` bench at n ≥ 1024.
